title: SHEVCHENKO: UKRAINE IS IN "EXACTLY THE DIVISION IT DESERVES"
description:
Ukraine's own legend says the table doesn't lie. Seven points from six games.

Andriy Shevchenko says Ukraine is in exactly the division it deserves, and the table backs him up. Third in a four-team Nations League group: two wins, one draw, three defeats. The second seeding pot for the Euro 2028 qualifying draw has gone.

The Northern Ireland game tells it best. Ukraine had 73% of the ball and put just 2 of 11 shots on target. They lost 0-3. Coach Maldera says resigning hasn't even been discussed with Shevchenko.

And the timing stings. Shevchenko won the Ballon d'Or in 2004, with 24 goals in 32 Serie A games. Last month in London he handed Lamine Yamal the Young Talent award. Yamal has three of those trophies. Ukraine has seven points.

Is Shevchenko being brutally honest or too hard on his own country? Pick a side in the comments.
